about: Extend an entry permit that is eligible for extension.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For visit, tourism, treatment, work mission and study permits
Visit permits for relatives or friends can extend up to 180 days in total; tourism permits up to 120 days
Border area, truck driver and 60-day visas for people abroad cannot be extended
documents: Papers submitted at issuance, depending on visa type
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
